sub: Equip your business with autonomous cloud bots that research, code, and execute workflows across 1,000+ tools around the clock.

manifesto: In America's fast-moving economy, speed and continuous execution define success. Ceyo runs tireless autonomous agents in the cloud, handling deep research, development, and multi-app workflows while you focus on high-impact strategic growth.

uses.d: Instruct a coding agent to scaffold web apps, run tests, and debug in its isolated cloud environment before deploying live.
Deploy autonomous browser agents to track SEC filings, pull earnings calls, and generate executive briefs every morning.
Monitor competitor pricing across Shopify and Amazon, auto-update Google Sheets inventories, and trigger inventory alerts.
Coordinate calls seamlessly across Eastern, Central, and Pacific hours with bots synced to Google Calendar and Gmail.
Assemble a team of Telegram bots that log client requests, update Notion boards, and push summaries to Slack channels.

steps.d: Select Plus, Pro, or Ultra to activate your 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens daily.
Integrate Gmail, Slack, Notion, and your developer tools into your bot's isolated cloud workspace.
Assign complex tasks, launch Telegram team chats, and let your bots run independently 24/7.

chapters.d: Your research agent analyzes overnight market moves and delivers a curated briefing directly to your private Telegram chat. You review the priorities before your first coffee.
While you are in product reviews, your coding agent builds a landing page, runs integration tests, and compiles the pull request in the cloud. It pings you the staging link the moment it finishes.
Your browser agent cross-references shipping rates and updates client records across your CRM and Google Sheets. The daily status report drops into your company Slack channel automatically.
Even after your laptop is closed and your phone is off, scheduled routines continue running uninterrupted on dedicated cloud servers. Tomorrow's competitive audit is ready before you wake up.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost, and how does the free trial work?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three plans: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; a card is linked upon signup and is only charged when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do my AI agents keep working when my computer or phone is off?
faq.a: Yes, every bot operates on its own dedicated, isolated cloud computer that runs 24/7. Your scheduled routines, browser automations, and coding workflows execute continuously without relying on your local hardware.

faq.q: Can I collaborate with my bots inside Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, you can interact with your bots via personal 1-on-1 Telegram chats or invite multiple specialized bots into group chats. They communicate with each other, share persistent memory, and operate as a collaborative workforce.

faq.q: What apps and platforms can Ceyo connect to?
faq.a: Ceyo connects to over 1,000 popular business applications including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, calendars, and major CRMs. Your agents can read data, trigger automations, and update records across your entire stack.

faq.q: What languages do Ceyo agents support?
faq.a: Ceyo agents support English and dozens of global languages fluently. They can research foreign markets, translate documentation, conduct multi-language voice calls, and draft localized reports effortlessly.
